'''Darth Vader's TIE Advanced''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], leading [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron]], and flown by him during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was a modified early prototype of the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] line, and in fact was the first of the limited production.

==Description==
[[File:TIEx1_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|180px|TIE Advanced x1 schematics.]]
The TIE Advanced x1 featured a greater speed than the TIE/LN. It was armed with heavy twin blaster cannons on fixed mounts, and was also capable of carrying secondary weapons such as [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missiles]]. In addition, unlike most [[TIE series/Legends|TIE models]], the TIE Advanced x1 was equipped with both a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a deflector shield generator and even a much more effective solar ionization reactor and stronger hull.<ref name="DSG">{{WebCite|url=http://www.revell.de/starwars/produkte/en-dv-tie-fighter.html|text=Star Wars - Darth Vader's TIE Fighter|work=[[Wikipedia:Revell|Revell]]'s [https://revell.com official website]|archivedate=20070701040607|nolive=1}}</ref>

The Advanced x1 had more cockpit capacity than other TIEs, thus catering to the larger-than-average figure of Darth Vader. It was built to Vader's specifications by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] at the [[Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratory/Legends|Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratory]].

Unlike the class standard, Vader's TIE Advanced apparently possessed a life-support system.<ref name="TFU 2">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The ship was hit by a strange T.I.E. Fighter that was tumbling out of control. Our hyperdrive initiated and drove us straight into this planet.|The [[Unidentified Tzarina survivor|survivor]] of the ''Tzarina'' crash, to a passing-by spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
Upon the completion of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] TIE Advanced x1 by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], Marketing Relations Manager [[Taed Augustus]] personally presented the new vessel to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Unfortunately Taed was far too familiar towards the Dark Lord, referring to him as "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]" more than once. Vader, unamused by the SFS official's lack of respect, [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked Augustus to]] [[Death/Legends|death]] mid-presentation.<ref name="TFU2n">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

While on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Darth Vader was personally overseeing the creation of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|late apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]]; the Dark Lord's customized TIE fighter served as his means of transportation to [[Timira City]] Cloning Facility where the Marek clones were located. Before Vader could execute the [[Subject 1138|latest imperfect clone]] who failed to meet his expectations, the clone broke free and slaughtered all of the Imperial machines and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that stood in his way. Vader, knowing that the clone sought to escape from Kamino, attempted to intercept the clone, but failed to prevent the clone's theft of the Dark Lord's own TIE fighter.<ref name="TFU2n" />

[[File:Vaders_TIE_Advanced.jpg|thumb|right|Vader's TIE Advanced x1]]
Utilizing Vader's TIE Advanced x1, the clone traveled to the Imperial-occupied world of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Since the TIE fighter was registered as Darth Vader's personal vessel, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] was under the belief that the Dark Lord was paying an unexpected visit, and thus sought to personally welcome Vader's arrival at the landing platform with a stormtrooper escort. To his surprise, however, the TIE fighter's pilot was unknown to him and quickly sought to execute the clone when it became apparent that he sought to [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|rescue]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]; the Imperials' attempts utterly failed and resulted in the deaths of many Imperials, including Tarko.<ref name="TFU2n" />

Soon after the events on Kamino and Cato Neimoidia, Vader later retrieved his ship, which later saw action during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. During the battle over the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], it was escorted by two handpicked [[Imperial pilot]]s flying standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. After destroying many of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fighters, it spun out of control when one of Vader's Black Squadron [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] collided with it in attempting to avoid cannon fire from the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The ship tumbled out of control in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] and eventually rammed the ''[[Tzarina]]'', a [[Passenger liner/Legends|luxury liner]] of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company. The impact initiated the liner's hyperdrive, thereby causing its crash on the distant planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:ac" /> Following the destruction of the Death Star, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] managed to regain control of his TIE x1 and made a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]], where he could land safely. His ship was damaged when it was hit by small [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in Vaal's orbit, and Vader was forced to make a crash-landing on the planet.<ref name="TSH">[[Empire 14|''Empire'' 14]]</ref> Upon his return to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Vader gave orders that his craft be recovered for repair and that it was to be docked in his personal ship, the ''Executor''.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />

Vader's TIE was later demolished while docked aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] as it crashed into the surface of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TNEGtVaV" /><ref name="Vader: The Ultimate Guide" />
